claims.subject: grant_amounts
claims.statement: The approved grant amount is one of three tiers: contents $2,000, minor structural $5,000, or major structural $10,000.
claims.quote: The approved amount is one of the three grant tiers: contents ($2,000), minor structural ($5,000) or major structural ($10,000).

claims.subject: application_fees
claims.statement: Applicants are never charged a fee at any stage of the application, assessment or payment process.
claims.quote: Applicants are never charged a fee at any stage of the application, assessment or payment process.

claims.subject: payment_account
claims.statement: Grants are paid only by electronic funds transfer into a bank account held in the applicant's own name.
claims.quote: Grants are paid only by electronic funds transfer into a bank account held in the applicant's own name.

claims.subject: other
claims.statement: Payments to third parties, agents or accounts in another person's name are not permitted.
claims.quote: Payments to third parties, agents or accounts in another person's name are not permitted.

claims.subject: other
claims.statement: Finance officers must not pay any amount other than a tier amount; mismatched assessments are returned to the assessment officer.
claims.quote: Finance officers must not pay any other amount.

claims.subject: other
claims.statement: The department will never ask an applicant to transfer money to any account; such requests are suspected fraud.
claims.quote: The department will never ask an applicant to transfer money to any account, and staff must treat any such request as suspected fraud.

claims.subject: other
claims.statement: Suspected fraud must be reported to Internal Audit on the same day it is identified, and no further payment released on the affected application until Internal Audit responds.
claims.quote: Report suspected fraud to Internal Audit on the same day it is identified, and do not release any further payment on the affected application until Internal Audit has responded.
